jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)

Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm. Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden. Dein Aufgabenbereich Startphase (erste Wochen): Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf. Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards. Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse. Im weiteren Verlauf: Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor. Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day. Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems. Success in this role means being able to: Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code. jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. jobs.title: Machine Learning Compiler Engineer
jobs.description: About the position We’re looking for compiler engineers to join a new ML Compilers Team at Jane Street.  Machine learning is a critical pillar of our global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Our ML team is full of people with a shared love for the craft of software engineering, and for designing APIs and systems that are delightful to use. ML compilers let us quickly turn research ideas and novel architectures into high-throughput training jobs and low-latency inference. To get the most out of our hardware resources and enable rapid model development and deployment, we are working to understand and improve the current ML compiler technologies and explore where it makes sense to build our own solutions. In this role, you would shape the development of our compiler stack. If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in. About you The ideal candidate has worked on an ML compiler in the past, but non-ML compiler experience is also valuable. Experience with any part of the stack is fine, be it high-level ML frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, TensorFlow), graph compilers (Inductor, XLA, TVM) or kernel DSLs (Triton, Helion, cuTile). jobs.description: The Role Join the UK’s market leading Financial Advisory Restructuring Tax team and make a real difference on a range of high profile and dynamic transactions. Our Financial Advisory Restructuring Tax team specialises in providing tax advice on the restructuring of financially distressed businesses. They have built a fantastic track record in recent years, leading on some of Europe’s largest and most complex restructuring processes. These include debt restructuring transactions, debt-for-equity swaps, business reconstructions via Restructuring Plans, Schemes of Arrangement and CVAs, and insolvency appointments. The variety of work really stands out, as does the friendly and supportive nature of the team. The team has a great mix of UK and international transactions work and is looking to recruit a corporation tax specialist at Associate Director level to build on the existing business capability and target a number of exciting developments in the restructuring market. This role is primarily advisory focused but will have some compliance responsibility. This is a unique opportunity to get involved. The role is technically interesting and personally rewarding. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe. jobs.description: Ingénieur de Recherche à l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée de l’ENSTA (F/H) : Contexte : ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, recherche et innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Début 2026, l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée de l’ENSTA (UEA, i3-CRG, CNRS) s’engage dans un projet de quatre ans financé par l’Agence Innovation Défense (AID). Ce projet s’appelle RésiCheVal ( Résilience des chaînes de valeur ). L’UEA s’intéresse à développer les outils permettant d’évaluer la capacité des filières associées à l’industrie de défense à résister dans un environnement géopolitique incertain où l’innovation technologique permanente est souvent une condition essentielle de la supériorité des forces armées. Activités principales L’ingénieur de recherche sera rattaché(e) à l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée (UEA). Il est attendu des candidat(e)s d’être en mesure : De contribuer à la production d’états de l’art sur les formalismes de théorie des graphes en matière d’étude des chaînes de valeur dans le domaine des biens d’armement. D’accompagner la production d’outils d’aide à la décision fondés sur ces formalismes. Avantages : Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %) Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an) Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le projet AMRIT : Aujourd’hui, en Europe, l’exploitation des plateformes d’observation in situ s’appuie sur un réseau d’infrastructures de recherche réparties sur l’ensemble du continent. Les activités menées au sein de ce réseau comprennent des opérations in situ et à distance en mer, ainsi que la gestion des données issues d’un grand nombre de ressources pour une large gamme d’applications. Ces activités nécessitent d’importantes ressources informatiques, des efforts de R&D visant à améliorer les capacités des plateformes, ainsi que des activités de gestion et de financement pour assurer le fonctionnement des infrastructures et en garantir l’accès. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) est un projet pionnier conçu pour révolutionner le paysage des infrastructures de recherche marine (MRI) en Europe, en renforçant leur capacité à répondre aux enjeux politiques européens et aux défis scientifiques mondiaux. AMRIT ( https://www.amritproject.eu/ ) est un projet financé par Horizon Europe et l’UKRI, réunissant 26 partenaires européens, et destiné à faire progresser les MRIs au plan de leur coordination, en proposant la fédération de certains de leurs services inform

As our investor base becomes increasingly global, you will partner closely with the firm’s fund administrator on escalated investor cases, lead enhanced due diligence on investors from higher-risk jurisdictions, and oversee the firm’s privacy compliance obligations, particularly under UK and European requirements. This is a chance to build, not just maintain: you’ll help shape our AML and privacy programmes as they grow. As part of the Compliance department, you will have broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and research groups, navigate issues related to the firm’s investment products in a fast-paced, evolving regulatory environment, and help develop policies and procedures to manage and mitigate regulatory requirements. We recruit prospective partners and support the onboarding and growth of existing ones as they build, launch, market, and scale their businesses through the Lovable Partner Ecosystem. We work closely with GTM partnerships, product partnerships, sales, and product marketing, and serve partner types from major technology and platform partners to the connectors, agencies, and independent experts who build with Lovable every day. Everyone else had to wait, or pay, or give up. Lovable is the counterargument: We exist for the people with ideas who were locked out of software creation until now. Over 70 million projects have been built on the platform. Hundreds of thousands of people pay for it. The product handles real infrastructure, not only prototypes: authentication, databases, payments, and deployment. People run real businesses on Lovable, which means the stakes are real too. The comms challenge: when anyone can build, the platform has to be safe for everyone who does, and they need to know it. That takes someone who can tell the story of how we think about topics like safety, security, and reliability before anyone asks, and who can be honest, precise, and fast when the questions come up anyway. What You Will Solve You will work on the  Agentic Harness , treating the LLM as a component within a larger, deterministic control system. Your research will focus on: Architecting loops that survive error accumulation. You will build verification layers that force the agent to recognize its own hallucinations and self-correct. You will implement systems where the agent compiles its own constraints and the harness enforces them via constrained decoding or external execution. You will optimise KV-cache hit rates and design "restorable compression" strategies to prevent attention decay. jobs.title: Founding Legal Engineer
jobs.description: About Grubel Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window. To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands. Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen. Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg. About the role You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice. Working directly with Grubel’s founding team, you will shape our research, development, and product: Translate complex legal processes into agentic workflows, evaluate our systems for legal soundness and utility, and work with customers to set our product and engineering standards. jobs.title: M&A – Praktikum / Intern (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Rolle Die Steuerberatung erlebt eine Konsolidierungswelle: Tausende Häuser suchen in den nächsten Jahren eine Nachfolge, und nur wenige Käufer prüfen sie mit derselben Sorgfalt wie ein professionelles Transaktionsteam. Hier lernst du M&A auf der Käuferseite, an echten Transaktionen und von der ersten Ansprache bis nach dem Abschluss. Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen und erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen, um sie weiterzuentwickeln. Wir prüfen laufend neue Ziele, bewerten, verhandeln und schließen ab. Anders als bei einem Finanzinvestor endet unsere Arbeit nicht beim Abschluss, sie fängt dort an. Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor oder im Master und willst den Transaktionsprozess vollständig kennenlernen, nicht nur einen Ausschnitt davon. Das Praktikum dauert drei bis sechs Monate in Vollzeit. Du arbeitest im Finance-Team und direkt mit der Geschäftsführung an laufenden Transaktionen. Deine Verantwortung Zielsuche und Marktanalyse Du baust Longlists und Shortlists möglicher Ziele, recherchierst Märkte, Wettbewerber und Nachfolgesituationen und bereitest Erstansprachen vor. Du wertest Teaser und erste Unterlagen aus und hältst in einer kurzen Einschätzung fest, ob sich eine vertiefte Prüfung lohnt. Bewertung und Due Diligence Du erstellst Bewertungen nach Multiplikatoren, Transaktionsvergleichen und Ertragswert, normalisierst Jahresabschlüsse und rechnest Kaufpreis-Mechanik und Sensitivitäten durch. jobs.title: Founding Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Tax advisory runs on structured data, recurring work and clear rules, and almost none of it has been rebuilt with modern software. What decides who gets there first is real case data and engineers who build next to the people doing the work. Vogel advises several thousand mid-sized companies and acquires established advisory firms, developing them further on one shared base. On top of the systems we buy, we build our own software: a data layer above DATEV, the tools our advisors use every day, and agents that take over recurring work. What counts is daily use, on data that is audited and closed. As one of our first engineers, you build across the whole stack: data pipelines, backend, the interfaces advisors use and the agents on top. You take a problem from the first conversation with an advisor to software that runs every day. We are hiring our CTO in parallel, who will own the architecture and lead the team. You work directly with Moritz Vogel. What you'll do Tools advisors use Sit with tax advisors and accountants on real cases, find where the work gets stuck, and turn it into software they use the next day. Your benchmark: an advisor would miss it if it were switched off. Build interfaces, dashboards and internal tools, from the first prototype to something that runs without you. Ship small and often: a tool in daily use beats a perfect plan. Data and integration Build the pipelines that move data out of DATEV and our other systems into our own data layer every night, checked from the first day. Define every figure exactly once, so a number means the same thing in every tool and report. Connect the systems each acquired firm brings, so one more firm never means one more integration project. Agents and automation Build agents that take over recurring work, with a clear line between what the model judges and what is calculated deterministically. Make every result traceable by version, source and decision, so a certified professional can sign off on

jobs.description: Canonical is building a comprehensive automation suite to provide multi-cloud and on-premise data solutions for the enterprise. The data platform team is a collaborative team that develops a managed solutions for a full range of data stores and data technologies, spanning from big data, through NoSQL, cache-layer capabilities, and analytics; all the way to structured SQL engines (similar to Amazon RDS approach). We are facing the interesting problem of fault-tolerant mission-critical distributed systems and intend to deliver the world's best automation solution for delivering managed data platforms. We are looking for candidates from junior to senior level with interests, experience and willingness to learn around Big Data technologies, such as distributed event-stores (Kafka) and parallel computing frameworks (Spark). Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of open-source community dynamics and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organisations. Location: This role can be filled in European, Middle East and African time zones. What your day will look like The data platform team is responsible for the automation of data platform operations, with the mission of managing and integrating Big Data platforms at scale. It combines acquiring and banking for B2B clients only, with €100M+ in annual revenue. About 100 people work there, around 15 of them in engineering. Replace the traditional PM → engineer handoff. Test the idea that engineering and product can work as one, with engineers talking directly to the business and domain experts. Move code writing to LLMs with automated QA. Start where mistakes are cheap and reach the critical financial components later. Hire engineers who talk to people and ask questions, not only write code. You can bring in 1–2 people who share the vision. Focus on internal efficiency. Met moderne cloud-technologie, duurzame oplossingen en hoge codekwaliteit maak jij samen met het team het verschil, niet alleen vandaag, maar juist voor de toekomst. Je kijkt verder vooruit dan de volgende release en je durft jezelf en het team uit te dagen. Daarnaast coach je de ontwikkelaars uit het team technisch en neem je initiatief om onze producten verder te brengen. Als Software Engineer bij IXON werk je aan een modern cloudplatform dat door duizenden machinebouwers wereldwijd wordt gebruikt. Geen remote eilandjes of kortlopende projecten, maar samen bouwen aan een product waar onze klanten fan van zijn. Klaar om impact te maken? Hier krijg jij energie van Binnen jouw rol als Software Engineer werk je niet aan een statische applicatie, maar aan een continu evoluerend cloudplatform met een diversiteit aan functionaliteiten. Samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het hart van de IXON Cloud: van complexe autorisatiestructuren tot een naadloze gebruikerservaring. Het doel? Onze klanten hun beheerprocessen zo efficiënt mogelijk laten uitvoeren. Om dat voor elkaar te krijgen, werk je met een moderne tech stack die onder andere bestaat uit Angular en TypeScript. Je krijgt de vrijheid om actief mee te beslissen over technische keuzes die ervoor zorgen dat onze applicaties niet alleen vandaag snel en strak draaien, maar ook op de lange termijn schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar blijven. Wat je concreet gaat doen: Je pakt de verantwoordelijkheid, en draagt zorg voor jouw kwalitatief sterke code; Je bent een sparringpartner voor je collega’s en om features technisch uit te diepen; Je tilt graag ons front-end delivery proces naar een hoger niveau, op gebied van observability, testing en deployment Je krijgt de ruimte voor PoC’s en research spikes om de nieuwste technologieën te valideren voor ons platform. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol Jij bent een Software Engineer die gelooft dat een interface pas écht goed is wanneer de logica erachter vlekkeloos werkt. Frontend is jouw passie, maar je snapt ook wat er in de backend gebeurt. Dit maakt je een belangrijke schakel in ons multidisciplinaire Scrum team. Je werkt iteratief, leert van feedback en streeft voortdurend naar verbetering. Bovendien inspireer

jobs.title: Product Solution Architect, Connectivity Solutions (all genders)
jobs.description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com . We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. As a Product Solution Architect , you translate complex, multi-team requirements into scalable, platform-ready concepts, from requirements gathering and product design through to technical architecture, without hands-on coding. You work with client-facing teams to solve client needs while keeping products coherent across tech verticals. You champion clean concepts, drive down technical debt, and advise engineering teams by analyzing codebases, evaluating standards, and guiding features to high-quality delivery. jobs.description: ad/mbo- praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij iemand die graag orde schept in de chaos? Krijg je energie van uitzoeken, structureren en dingen overzichtelijk maken? Werk je graag met digitale systemen? Dit is jouw uitdaging We hebben honderden documenten met informatie over ons beleid en genomen besluiten. Deze documenten zijn relevant voor veel collega’s. Om die reden willen we de documenten graag op een overzichtelijke manier aanbieden, zodat alle collega’s snel en makkelijk het document kunnen vinden dat ze zoeken. We hebben al een idee hoe we dit willen gaan doen. Tijdens jouw stage ga je ons idee verder uitwerken en in de praktijk toepassen. Dit zijn de concrete activiteiten: Je gaat alle beleidsdocumenten verzamelen die nu nog op verschillende plekken zijn opgeslagen. Je maakt een mappenstructuur aan, waarin de documenten op een logische plek komen te staan. Je deelt de documenten in volgens de nieuwe structuur en voorziet ze van labels en metadata voor een optimale vindbaarheid. Je controleert of documenten dubbel voorkomen en verwijdert dubbele, verouderde en niet meer relevante documenten. Je kijkt of de nieuwe structuur in de praktijk goed werkt en of gebruikers de documenten gemakkelijk kunnen terugvinden. Je signaleert knelpunten en doet waar nodig voorstellen voor verbeteringen. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen Je loopt stage bij het team Staf van Dataverzameling (DVZ) van het CBS in Heerlen. jobs.description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre du projet CARBURE (projet DGA Rapid mené en partenariat avec la société eXO maKina), qui vise l'explicabilité de la prise de décision dans la lutte contre la falsification d'images à partir de réseaux profonds, nous recrutons une ingénieure ou un ingénieur de recherche et développement au sein de notre Département Sciences des Données. En collaboration avec l’équipe du projet et les équipes de recherche partenaires, vous aurez pour mission principale de développer un outil d'accompagnement à l'analyse et à l'explicabilité de la falsification d'images. Vous concevrez une architecture reposant sur des RAGs multimodaux spécialisés (liés à l'interprétation des filtres du logiciel Tungstène) et assurerez leur synthèse dynamique. Vous mettrez également en place un démonstrateur (PoC) autonome fonctionnant hors réseau et valoriserez ces travaux par la rédaction de livrables techniques et de publications scientifiques. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role Samsara is a leader in a dynamic market. As a public company listed on the NYSE with $2.1B in ARR, we deliver mission-critical solutions to physical operations globally. This position is tailored for high-performing professionals seeking to accelerate their professional growth. jobs.title: Audit Methodology Lead
jobs.description: We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar. You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. jobs.title: Senior QA Specialist
jobs.description: About us Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast. As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows. What you'll do Join refinement with the Integrations team and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests Test new integrations and API changes end to end: our side, the partner’s side, and everything that can go wrong between them (auth, rate limits, partial syncs, retries, data mapping) Explore beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira Build and maintain automated tests in TypeScript, with API and contract tests alongside Playwright E2E tests, and review the tests developers write in pull requests Own the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions: triage failure

jobs.description: Your Mission: As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway. Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure. Evaluate high-temperature and fire protection materials, such as phenolic and high-char-yield composites, silicone systems, ceramics, and intumescent materials, for thermal runaway containment. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap (PATT) BPJS Kesehatan
jobs.description: Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial ( BPJS ) Kesehatan adalah badan hukum yang dibentuk untuk menyelenggarakan program jaminan kesehatan sebagaimana diamanatkan dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 40 Tahun 2004 Tentang Sistem Jaminan Sosial Nasional dan Undang-Undang Nomor 24 Tahun 2011 tentang Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial yang bertugas untuk menyelenggarakan jaminan Kesehatan Nasional bagi seluruh rakyat Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah Rekrutmen Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap BPJS Kesehatan. BPJS Kesehatan mulai resmi beroperasi pada 1 Januari 2014. Dasar pendirian beroperasinya BPJS Kesehatan adalah pada tahun 2004 pemerintah mengeluarkan UU Nomor 40 Tahun 2004 tentang Sistem Jaminan Sosial Nasional (SJSN) dan kemudian pada tahun 2011 pemerintah menetapkan UU Nomor 24 Tahun 2011 tentang Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial (BPJS). Visi: Menjadi badan penyelenggara yang dinamis, akuntabel, dan terpercaya untuk mewujudkan jaminan kesehatan yang berkualitas, berkelanjutan, berkeadilan, dan inklusif. Rekrutmen Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap BPJS Kesehatan Saat ini BPJS Kesehatan membuka rekrutmen lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap (PATT) Staf Kedeputian Wilayah dan Kantor Cabang Job Description Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap (PATT) adalah Pegawai Tidak Tetap yang direkrut untuk mendukung pelaksanaan fungsi organisasi BPJS Kesehatan sesuai dengan kebutuhan unit kerja. Sebagai PATT Staf, Anda akan berperan dalam mendukung kegiatan operasional, administrasi, serta tugas-tugas lain sesuai dengan bidang dan kebutuhan unit kerja penempatan. Ruang lingkup tugas akan disesuaikan dengan jabatan dan unit kerja masing-masing. Bank ini menjadi bank pertama yang memelopori pertukaran mata uang asing dengan menjadi bank devisa pertama di Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk. PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk (IDX Code: BDMN) yang berdiri sejak 1956, per 30 Juni 2021 mengelola total aset konsolidasi sebesar Rp 194 triliun bersama anak perusahaannya, yaitu PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk. (Adira Finance). Dalam hal kepemilikan saham, 92,47% saham Danamon dimiliki oleh MUFG Bank, Ltd. dan 7,53% dimiliki oleh publik. Danamon didukung oleh 846 jaringan kantor cabang konvensional, unit Syariah dan kantor cabang anak perusahaannya serta lebih dari 60.000 jaringan ATM Danamon, ATM Bersama, PRIMA dan ALTO yang tersebar di 34 provinsi. Selain jaringan fisik, layanan Danamon juga dapat diakses melalui Danamon Online Banking, mobile banking melalui aplikasi D-Bank dan D-Card, SMS Banking, serta layanan phone banking melalui Hello Danamon. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

jobs.description: At Curtins, we re an employee-owned engineering consultancy driven by a simple ambition: to create a better built environment for everyone. For over 65 years, we ve delivered practical, innovative and sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities across the UK and Ireland. From major regeneration schemes and commercial developments to education, healthcare and residential projects, our work helps shape the places where people live, learn, work and thrive. As a Graduate Transport Planner, you ll work alongside experienced planners, engineers and consultants, contributing to a wide range of projects while developing the technical and professional skills you need to build your career. What you ll be doing You will support the planning and development process, helping clients bring projects forward from initial concept through to planning approval. Your responsibilities will include: Assisting with the preparation of Transport Assessments and Transport Statements. Supporting the production of Travel Plans and technical planning reports. Analysing traffic, transport and movement data. Assisting with junction assessments and development impact studies. Supporting planning applications for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments. Working alongside planners, civil engineers and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions. Attending client meetings, project discussions and stakeholder consultations. Taking part in wider Curtins activities including STEM outreach, charity initiatives and community projects. What kind of projects will I get to work on? You ll be involved in projects across a wide range of sectors, including: Residential developments. Urban regeneration schemes.

jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description: The HR Manager will manage and improve the company’s overall HR operations. This role will help ensure that HR policies, systems, and practices are aligned with business goals, labor laws, and employee needs. The successful candidate will act as a trusted partner to management and employees. They will help build a positive, compliant, and productive workplace while supporting employee growth and organizational development. Duties and Responsibilities Lead the full cycle of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, compensation and benefits, performance management, training, and employee engagement. Develop, update, and implement HR policies, procedures, and programs that support company goals and comply with Philippine labor laws and DOLE requirements. Manage end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition strategies to attract qualified candidates through job platforms, LinkedIn, referrals, and other sourcing channels. Improve employee experience by supporting engagement programs, workplace communication, employee feedback, and retention initiatives. Partner with department heads and managers to understand staffing needs, employee concerns, and organizational goals. Guide managers and employees on HR policies, workplace concerns, disciplinary actions, grievance handling, and conflict resolution. Ensure accurate and timely administration of compensation, benefits, government-mandated benefits, employee records, and HR documentation. Monitor HR metrics such as hiring timelines, turnover, attendance, employee engagement, and training needs to support better decision-making. Plan and implement training and development programs to improve employee skills, leadership capability, and work performance. Support performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and employee development plans.
